newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki to rebuild auto parts plant - paper.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki to rebuild auto parts plant - paper.

text.p: Aisin Seiki Co Ltd will rebuild by the end of March 1999 a car parts plant that burned down in February, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday.
The fire at the auto parts supplier forced Japanese car giant Toyota Motor Corp to temporarily suspend most of its domestic production.
Aisin, which ships about 90 percent of its products to Toyota, was supplying brake-related products, including proportioning valves.
The total cost of the reconstruction would be several billion yen, the paper said.
An Aisin spokesman said that the company had not yet decided on a reconstruction plan.
